run_GetTestsForAllIterations: run the test program with env vars and args to get a list of tests per iteration
run_GetTestCases: run GetTestCases on a list of full test names to extract unique test case names
run_CalculateTestLists: run CalculateTestLists to populate all test lists including shuffled and filtered variants
test_GTestShuffleUnitTest: test that shuffling preserves test count, changes order, and does not interleave test cases
run_RunAndReturnOutput: run the gtest test program with custom env and args and return its output
